frames.name: F00_READY
frames.note: GK_BASE_V1 SET/west, untouched

frames.name: F01_WEIGHT_SHIFT
frames.note: weight onto the LEFT (save-side) foot, knees soften, head on the ball, hands drop

frames.name: F02_CROUCH
frames.note: hips down and onto the LEFT leg, LEFT knee deeper than the RIGHT, arms back

frames.name: F03_PLANT_LOAD
frames.note: hips lowest and over the LEFT foot; LEFT leg accepts the weight (deep knee), RIGHT heel lifting (+14°), arms fully back, hands start toward the target

frames.name: F04_PUSH_OFF
frames.note: LEFT leg extending from the planted toe (hips 2 px up), RIGHT foot off the ground (+3,−6), both arms swinging forward to the save side, elbows 35 % open

frames.name: F05_TOE_OFF
frames.note: LEFT leg fully extended on the toe (boot +30°), hips 2.6 px up and driving, RIGHT leg unloaded and trailing (+5,−12), elbows 55 % open, gloves at the target line

frames.name: F05b_LEAVING_GROUND
frames.note: first airborne tick: both feet just off the pitch, legs hanging behind the hips (LEFT leg still nearly straight from the push, RIGHT knee bent), hips 3 px up, elbows 70 % open

frames.name: F06_EARLY_FLIGHT
frames.note: hands leading at the ball, torso rolling (width 0.88) as the hips rise; legs trailing straight behind the hips — pointing away from the camera, so short (0.66) with the knees folding

frames.name: F07_MID_FLIGHT
frames.note: arms straight at the ball, torso side-on (width 0.83, foreshortened), hips level with the head, legs folded tight behind/above the hips (0.60): the most compact moment of the dive

frames.name: F07b_BRIDGE
frames.note: the last GK_BASE_V1 frame with the contact art's head (0.86 → 7.0 px area-equivalent, like the Pro head), shoulder width (0.78), limb thickness (0.82), palette and thinned outlines; legs extending up-left into the contact angle, arms fully extended (+4 px) with the far arm reaching past the near one

frames.name: F06m_EARLY_FLIGHT_MOD
frames.note: moderate variant: elbows 70 % open, arm reach +1 px, legs folded tighter (0.66)

frames.name: F07m_MID_FLIGHT_MOD
frames.note: moderate variant: elbows 85 % open, arm reach +2 px, legs folded (0.62)

frames.name: F07c_BRIDGE_PRO_A
frames.note: the contact art's own components 22° short of the contact orientation with a 75 % outline — the first Pro-part frame, posed to match F07b's silhouette (arms at 83°, legs at the F07b angle, knees 10–12° bent)

frames.name: F08_BRIDGE_PRO
frames.note: the contact art's own components 14° short of the contact orientation with a 50 % outline (fading the base style out): arms 30° short of overhead, knees 6–8° bent, legs at the contact angle

frames.name: F09_FINAL_EXTENSION
frames.note: 5° short of the contact orientation, arms 14° short, knees 2° short, 25 % outline: the last authored frame before the untouched contact PNG

frames.name: F11_POST_CONTACT
frames.note: momentum: body 4° past contact, gloves 10° through the ball line, knees starting to fold

frames.name: F11b_APEX
frames.note: the rise has stopped; gloves easing off the ball line

frames.name: F12_DESCENT
frames.note: falling on the contact diagonal, arms folding under to brace, knees bending

frames.name: F12b_FALLING
frames.note: arms reaching for the pitch, knees folding further

frames.name: F13_GROUND_CONTACT
frames.note: left hip and forearm meet the pitch at the presentation root, gloves bracing under the chest, knees folded

frames.name: F13b_SETTLING
frames.note: trunk settling onto the left side, knees drawing up

frames.name: F14_ABSORB
frames.note: flat on the left side, torso compressed 6 %, arms tucked, knees up: the impact goes into the hip/forearm

frames.name: F15a_PUSH_UP
frames.note: upper body pushing up off the forearm/gloves (torso 40° up, foreshortened toward the camera), head turning to the play, knees drawn under

frames.name: F15a2_SITTING_UP
frames.note: trunk upright to the knees, head above the hips, hands on the pitch: the last Pro-part frame (60 % outline)

frames.name: F15a3_HALF_KNEEL
frames.note: sitting back on the LEFT heel, RIGHT foot planted forward, trunk low (0.78) and just lifting, hands on the pitch/thigh; style 80 % toward the Pro look so it meets F15a2

frames.name: F15b_KNEELING
frames.note: LEFT knee down (shin folded back), RIGHT foot forward and planted, torso up, hands on the thigh, head up; style 55 %

frames.name: F16_RISING
frames.note: up on both feet in a deep crouch (hips 10 px down), hands coming up to the ready position; style 25 %

frames.name: F17_READY
frames.note: GK_BASE_V1 SET/west, untouched
